scripts.text: ^3355FFWait a second! Right now, you're carrying too many items with you. Please come back after putting some of your things into Kafra Storage.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF等一下！您現在攜帶的物品太多了。請先將部分物品存入卡普拉倉庫，然後再回來。^000000

scripts.text:
[Granny]
I wish I could make some clothing for my grandchildren for the festival season...
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
我真希望能給孫輩們做幾件節日穿的衣服...

scripts.text:
[Granny]
Oh! Would you give me your ^3355FFSkirt of Virgin^000000? I'd need four of them. Please, I'm begging you.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
哦！能把你的^3355FF韓服^000000給我嗎？我需要四件。拜託了，求求你了。

scripts.text: Alright.
scripts.translation: 好的。

scripts.text: No way!
scripts.translation: 絕對不行！

scripts.text:
[Granny]
Oh! Thank you so much~ Now I can make some clothes for Kitty Cutty~
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
哦！太感謝你了~ 現在我可以給小貓咪做衣服了~

scripts.text:
[Granny]
Ah, Wait! I almost forgot. I was quite a popular actress back in my youth. My actor friends gave me a wedding present when I left the Troupe. I've kept it to remind me of those precious times.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
啊，等等！我差點忘了。我年輕時曾是個很受歡迎的演員。離開劇團時，我的演員朋友們送了我一份結婚禮物。我一直留著它，以紀念那段珍貴的時光。

scripts.text:
[Granny]
If it's okay...
I'd like to give you this.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
如果不介意的話...
我想把這個送給你。

scripts.text:
[Granny]
Goodbye, adventurer~!
Thank you for making an old woman so happy...
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
再見了，冒險者~！
謝謝你讓一個老婦人如此開心...

scripts.text:
[Granny]
*Sigh* How can I get ^3355FFSkirt of Virgin^000000 by myself? I'm just so weak and feeble, even rolling in my rocking chair exhausts me. *Sniff* All I want is to make my grandchildren happy...
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
*嘆氣* 我自己怎麼才能得到^3355FF韓服^000000呢？我身體太虛弱了，連搖著搖椅都累得夠嗆。*抽泣* 我只想讓孫輩們開心...

scripts.text:
[Granny]
I gather Mushrooms on the Mountain of Payon everyday. Time passes and before I know it, it's already fesitval season. I wish I could make clothing for my family this time of the year.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
我每天都在斐揚山上採蘑菇。時間過得真快，不知不覺又到了節日季。我真希望能在這個時節為家人做幾件衣服。

scripts.text:
[Granny]
...
But for that, I need ^3355FF4 Skirt of Virgin^000000...

[Granny]
Young traveler, please help me. When you find some ^3355FFSkirt of Virgin^000000, please bring them to me. I'd really appreciate it...
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
年輕的旅行者，請幫幫我。如果你找到^3355FF韓服^000000，請帶給我。我會非常感激的...

scripts.text:
[Mystic Lady]
My family has produced and sold the special Winter product ^3355FFEar Muffs^000000 for many years. We just moved here, but the weather is always warm so we can hardly make a living.
scripts.translation:
[神秘女士]
我家多年來一直生產並銷售冬季特供品^3355FF耳罩^000000。我們剛搬到這裡，但這裡天氣總是很暖和，所以生意很難做。

scripts.text:
[Mystic Lady]
If you plan to travel to colder regions, I suggest that you bring some ^3355FFEar Muffs^000000...
scripts.translation:
[神秘女士]
如果你打算去更冷的地區旅行，我建議帶一些^3355FF耳罩^000000...

scripts.text:
[Mystic Lady]
Ear Muffs are my family's specialty, and we provide it to customers who have ^FF33551 Cursed Ruby^000000, ^3311AA1 Headset,^000000 ^3355FF 200 Feathers^000000 and ^DDDD005000 Zeny^000000.
scripts.translation:
[神秘女士]
耳罩是我家的特產，我們向擁有^FF33551顆詛咒紅寶石^000000、^3311AA1個頭戴式耳機^000000、^3355FF200根羽毛^000000和^DDDD005000 Zeny^000000的顧客提供耳罩。

scripts.text: Oh Yeah? That sounds good.
scripts.translation: 哦，是嗎？聽起來不錯。

scripts.text: No thank you, Ma'am.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝女士。

scripts.text:
[Mystic Lady]
Here, I will give you this pre-made one.
scripts.translation:
[神秘女士]
給你，這是預先做好的。

scripts.text:
[Mystic Lady]
Thank you for buying our product. You won't regret purchasing our Ear Muffs: Satisfaction guaranteed~
scripts.translation:
[神秘女士]
感謝購買我們的產品。你不會後悔買我們的耳罩的：保證滿意~

scripts.text:
[Mystic Lady]
Oh dear...
You don't have enough money or items. Unfortunately, we can't give any discounts. Please understand that we have to make a living...
scripts.translation:
[神秘女士]
哎呀...
你的錢或物品不夠。很遺憾，我們無法提供折扣。請理解我們需要謀生...

scripts.text:
[Mystic Lady]
That's fine.
I believe we
will meet again.
...One of these days.
scripts.translation:
[神秘女士]
沒關係。
我相信我們
還會再見的。
...總有一天。

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
ArrrGggghh!
Ah, No I can't...
scripts.translation:
[年輕男子]
啊...啊...啊...！
啊，不行，我做不到...

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
*Huk*
Now even my eyes have gone mad!! Why do these bugs suddenly seem so cute?! Nooooooo~!!!
scripts.translation:
[年輕男子]
*噗*
現在連我的眼睛都瘋了！！為什麼這些蟲子突然看起來這麼可愛？！不~~~~~！！！

scripts.text: Show Ora Ora
scripts.translation: 展示尤拉尤拉

scripts.text: Give Ora Ora
scripts.translation: 交出尤拉尤拉

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
Oooooohhhh!!!
Is, is this
the one?!
This is...
Ora Ora!!
scripts.translation:
[年輕男子]
噢噢噢噢！！
這、這是
那個嗎？！
這就是...
尤拉尤拉！！

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
I'll make it short! Give it to me, and I will give you my treasure! So how's my idea? Wanna deal?
scripts.translation:
[年輕男子]
長話短說！把它給我，我就把我的寶物給你。怎麼樣？這筆交易划算嗎？

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
Muhahahahah!!!
I finally have this!
Ora Ora!
Stupid and Disgusting
Thief Bugs!!
You will pay!!!
scripts.translation:
[年輕男子]
穆哈哈哈哈哈！！
我終於得到它了！
尤拉尤拉！
愚蠢又噁心的
浮勒盜蟲！！
你們要付出代價！！！

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
Huk...Huk...
Sorry, I was out of control with pleasure for a while. Now, I will give my treasure as promised.
scripts.translation:
[年輕男子]
呼...呼...
抱歉，剛才我因為太興奮而失控了。現在，我會遵守承諾，把寶物給你。

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
When you wear this over your mouth and start to breathe, it filters junk out before getting to your lungs.
scripts.translation:
[年輕男子]
把它戴在嘴上開始呼吸時，它會在空氣進入肺部之前過濾掉雜質。

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
Kakakakakaka!
I can't wait
to use this
Ora Ora!
scripts.translation:
[年輕男子]
卡卡卡卡卡！
我迫不及待
想使用這個
尤拉歐拉了！

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
Huhuhuhuhu...
What if I can't get rid of all these Thief Bugs? I might even grow to love them... *Huk*
scripts.translation:
[年輕男子]
呼呼呼呼...
萬一我沒能除掉所有這些浮勒盜蟲怎麼辦？我甚至可能會愛上它們... *噗*

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
Wahhhhhh! I, I...
I can't take it any more!
You little stinky filthy bastards!
scripts.translation:
[年輕男子]
哇啊啊啊！我、我...
我受不了了！
你們這群又臭又髒的混蛋！

scripts.text: Continue
scripts.translation: 繼續

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
Oh man...
It all started when my parents passed away when I was a little kid. Early on I had to work for a living, and had a really hard time.
scripts.translation:
[年輕男子]
天哪...
這一切都從我小時候父母去世開始。我很早就得出來謀生，日子過得非常艱難。

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
I've worked for 10 years in hopes of buying my dream house where I could find some sense of peace and comfort again. Eventually I thought I had enough zeny to afford my very own sweet home.
scripts.translation:
[年輕男子]
我工作了10年，希望能買到夢想中的房子，在那裡找回一些平靜和舒適。最終我以為我攢夠了Zeny，可以買一個屬於我自己的甜蜜小窩了。

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
Unfortunately I didn't have enough money to buy the nice house that I had my eye on. But then, I found this house, which was bigger and cheaper than the first. I bought it without thinking...
scripts.translation:
[年輕男子]
不幸的是，我沒有足夠的錢買下我看中的那棟漂亮房子。但後來，我發現了這棟房子，它比第一棟更大更便宜。我沒怎麼想就買下了...

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
Sweet Jesus! Turns out, it's a Heaven for Thief Bugs!!!
scripts.translation:
[年輕男子]
天哪！原來這裡是浮勒盜蟲的天堂！！！

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
I tried to do everything I could do. I coaxed them, killed them, but it only brought peace for a moment! I even tried to burn this house down...!
scripts.translation:
[年輕男子]
我試遍了所有辦法。我哄它們，殺它們，但只能換來片刻的安寧！我甚至試過把這房子燒掉...！

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
*Gasp* I mean, really, do I need ^3355FF Ora Ora^000000 to get rid of them? People say it is very rarely seen in distant countries.
scripts.translation:
[年輕男子]
*倒吸涼氣* 我是說，真的，我需要^3355FF 尤拉尤拉^000000來除掉它們嗎？人們說這在遙遠的國家很少見。

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
If I could afford 5 of them, I won't have to be frustrated with these disgusting bugs any more...
scripts.translation:
[年輕男子]
如果我能買得起5個，我就不必再為這些噁心的蟲子煩惱了...

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
This never ending fight with the bugs has really exhausted me. I give up. Do as you wish you scumbags!
scripts.translation:
[年輕男子]
這場與蟲子沒完沒了的戰鬥真的讓我精疲力竭。我放棄了。你們這群人渣，愛怎麼樣就怎麼樣吧！

scripts.text:
[Young man]
...What is it?
scripts.translation:
[年輕男子]
...怎麼了？

scripts.text: Can you make me a special item?
scripts.translation: 你能給我製作一個特殊物品嗎？

scripts.text: Hey.
scripts.translation: 嘿。

scripts.text:
[Young man]
Huh? So you already know what I specialize in, eh? I suppose there's no need for the usual secrecy. Tell me what you want.
scripts.translation:
[年輕男子]
哦？看來你已經知道我的專長是什麼了。既然這樣，也沒必要再守口如瓶了。告訴我，你想要什麼。

scripts.text: Helm of Angel.
scripts.translation: 天使頭盔

scripts.text: Deviruchi Cap.
scripts.translation: 小惡魔帽

scripts.text: I will come next time.
scripts.translation: 我下次再來。

scripts.text:
[Young man]
1 Helm (with slot).
1 Angel Wing.
5 Fang of Garm.
That's all I require.
scripts.translation:
[年輕男子]
1個頭盔（帶插槽）。
1個天使髮圈。
5個獅鷲獸的指甲。
只需要這些。

scripts.text:
[Young man]
Wait! Just so you know, I don't care if the items in your inventory have been upgraded, or have cards attached.
scripts.translation:
[年輕男子]
等等！先說明一下，我不在乎你背包裡的物品是否經過強化，或者插了卡片。

scripts.text:
[Young man]
I mean, any cards or upgrades in the items I will use to make something for you will be lost once I make the item. So be careful when you hand stuff over to me.
scripts.translation:
[年輕男子]
我的意思是，用來製作物品的材料上附帶的任何卡片或強化等級，在製作完成後都會消失。所以把東西交給我之前，請三思。

scripts.text:
[Young man]
Did you gather the items? Then hand them over.
scripts.translation:
[年輕男子]
材料都集齊了嗎？那就交給我吧。

scripts.text: Give him the items.
scripts.translation: 把物品交給他。

scripts.text: Don't give him the items.
scripts.translation: 不給他物品

scripts.text:
[Young man]
.....Hm.
Fine, here's your Helm of Angel. Take it.
scripts.translation:
[年輕男子]
……嗯。
好了，這是你的天使頭盔。拿去吧。

scripts.text:
[Young man]
...The number of items is not right. You better double check.
scripts.translation:
[年輕男子]
……材料數量不對。你最好再檢查一下。

scripts.text:
[Young man]
Do as you wish...
scripts.translation:
[年輕男子]
隨你便……

scripts.text:
[Young man]
600 Little Evil Horn.
40 Talon of Griffon.
That's all I require.
scripts.translation:
[年輕男子]
600個小惡魔角。
40個獅鷲獸的指甲。
只需要這些。

scripts.text:
[Young man]
Wait! Just so you know, I don't care if the items in your inventory have been upgraded, or have cards attached.
scripts.translation:
[年輕男子]
等等！先說明一下，我不在乎你背包裡的物品是否經過強化，或者插了卡片。

scripts.text:
[Young man]
I mean, any cards or upgrades in the items I will use to make something for you will be lost once I make the item. So be careful when you hand stuff over to me.
scripts.translation:
[年輕男子]
我的意思是，用來製作物品的材料上附帶的任何卡片或強化等級，在製作完成後都會消失。所以把東西交給我之前，請三思。

scripts.text:
[Young man]
Did you gather the items? Then hand them over.
scripts.translation:
[年輕男子]
材料都集齊了嗎？那就交給我吧。

scripts.text: Give him the items.
scripts.translation: 把物品交給他。

scripts.text: Don't give him the items.
scripts.translation: 不給他物品

scripts.text:
[Young man]
.....Hm. Here's your Deviruchi Hat. Please take it.
scripts.translation:
[年輕男子]
……嗯。這是你的小惡魔帽。請拿好。

scripts.text:
[Young man]
...The number of items isn't right. You better double check.
scripts.translation:
[年輕男子]
……材料數量不對。你最好再檢查一下。

scripts.text:
[Young man]
Do as you wish...
scripts.translation:
[年輕男子]
隨你便……

scripts.text:
[Young man]
Hm. Alright.
Then we shall meet again.
scripts.translation:
[年輕男子]
嗯。好的。
那我們下次再見。

scripts.text:
[Young man]
Hm.
Take care.
scripts.translation:
[年輕男子]
嗯。
保重。
